meta.title: Sideline Padel
meta.description: Log your matches, follow your progress and arrange games with players at your level.

landing.heroSubtitle: Log every match, watch your level evolve, and find people to play with near you.

features.trackBody: Every match counts. Win rate, streaks, level progression and who you played with.
features.levelBody: You declare your category and the community weighs in. Your matchmaking level comes from both.
features.matchBody: Post that you need players, or join someone else's game. With a reminder before you play.

landing.previewLabel: App preview: a player's summary with 24 matches, a 63% win rate and a 3-match streak, and a match won 3-6, 6-3, 7-5.

how.title: How it works
how.intro: Sideline is your padel notebook: you log what you play and the app turns it into stats, an honest level and, very soon, people to play with.

track.title: Log every match
track.body: With the gold "Log match" button, in under a minute.
track.p1: A match with set-by-set score, a quick match (just who won) or a training session.
track.p2: You don't enter whether you won: the result comes from the score.
track.p3: Pick the club from the list and you get a link to open it in Google Maps.

stats.title: See how you're doing
stats.body: Home shows your summary as soon as you sign in.
stats.p1: Win percentage, with how many you won and lost.
stats.p2: Your current streak and your recent form (W, L, D).
stats.p3: How many matches you played this month, and every match with its scoreboard, TV style.

level.title: Your level, honestly
level.body: A number from 1 to 7, built from what you say and what the people you play with say.
level.p1: Declared: the one you set. Nobody changes it.
level.p2: Perceived: what people who played with you think. Shown only after 3 opinions, and every vote is private.
level.p3: Effective: a blend of both. Next to it you see an estimated category (for example, ≈ 5ta in Argentina), an approximation, not an official category.
level.soonNote: Rating the level of people you played with is coming soon.

venues.title: Clubs nationwide
venues.body: Clubs come from OpenStreetMap, the free map, and players fill in the rest.
venues.p1: Search without worrying about accents or capitals.
venues.p2: If your club is missing, add it with province and city. If someone already added it under another name, the app notices and uses that one.
venues.p3: Once 3 different players log matches there, the club is verified.

offers.title: Games
offers.body: For when you're short of players.
offers.p1: Post the game with the level you're looking for and others join.
offers.p2: Each player confirms they're going, and you get a reminder before playing.

how.privacy1: Your email and date of birth are never shown to anyone.
how.privacy2: Opinions about your level are private: only the result is published.
how.privacy3: Sideline is for people aged 16 and over.

disclaimer.noBooking: Sideline does not book courts. Book with your club, then post the game once you have it.

level.categoryApprox: Approximate category, estimated from your declared level and what other players rated you. Not an official tournament category.
level.categoryApproxWithRange: Estimated from your declared level and what other players rated you. Covers {min} to {max}. Not an official tournament category.

panel.emptyBody: Log what you played and you'll see your win rate, your streak and how your level evolves.

profile.editSoon: Soon you'll be able to edit your details and declared level here.

steps.publishBody: Got a court and missing players? Post it with the day, time, club and the level you are looking for. Always four players.
steps.joinBody: See open games near you and at your level, and ask for a spot. You can sign up as confirmed or "to be confirmed".
steps.remindBody: We remind you 30 minutes before you play. And if someone drops out, everyone who confirmed finds out right away.

offers.meanwhile: Meanwhile, keep logging your matches: that builds your level, which is what will match you with others.
